[quote=demste;58338881]O almirante Miguel Soares pisava suas botas sobre o Cruzador Cisne Branco, apertando a gravata no terno mal-ajustado que usava. Uma mão distraidamente coçou a barba por fazer em seu queixo, enquanto observava o oceano azul.
ALMIRANTE SOARES
um dos fuzileiros chegou rapidamente ao convés com um telegrama em mãos.
senhor almirante, Gendarme já fez seu movimento e denunciou Arenett devido às hostilidades
Almirante Soares olhou para o fuzileiro, seus olhos mostravam satisfação.
Então a guerra virá logo em breve, aumentem  a velocidade, devemos chegar na Ilha antes da guerra começar, antes do amanhecer de preferência.
sim senhor
O fuzileiro foi rapidamente despachado, o Almirante entrou então na cabine de comando, a qual apenas ele e outros oficiais de alto escalão tinham acesso, lá havia, em monitores , com luzes verdes acesas mostrando em telas mostrando cada navio da frota. 
Sua frota foi dividida em 2 grupos de combate principais. 
Os dois grupos estavam divididos em funções, o primeiro grupo era o principal, liderado pelo Cisne Branco, tendo outros 23 navios a acompanhando, o segundo grupo tinha 20 navios, era composto por cruzadores e contratorpedeiros, eles estavam verificando perímetro e verificando quaisquer possíveis ameaças na região.
*relatório naval, ameaça de frotas inimigas não detectadas*
Atrás da frota estendia-se o trem de logística, 32  embarcações de logística, doze embarcações de assalto anfíbio, transportando os soldados necessários para a operação ,  e uma dúzia de escolta de submarinos de ataque desviados de suas outras frotas,  eles  bem dentro do perímetro defensivo de sua frota, então não deveria ser problema se preocupar 
[nation]Gendarme[/nation]
[nation]Goleornacha[/nation]

[Spoiler= translating]
Admiral Miguel Soares stepped onto the White Swan Cruiser with his boots, tightening his tie on the ill-fitting suit he wore. One hand absently scratched the stubble on his chin as he gazed out at the blue ocean.
ADMIRAL SOARES
one of the marines quickly arrived on deck with a telegram in hand.
Sir Admiral, the Gendarme has already made his move and denounced Arenett due to hostilities
Admiral Soares looked at the marine, his eyes showing satisfaction.
Then war will come soon, increase speed, we must reach the Island before the war starts, preferably before dawn.
Yes sir
The marine was quickly dispatched, the Admiral then entered the command cabin, which only he and other high-ranking officers had access to, there were monitors with green lights on screens showing each ship in the fleet.
His fleet was divided into 2 main combat groups.
The two groups were divided into roles, the first group was the main one, led by the White Swan, with 23 other ships accompanying it, the second group had 20 ships, was composed of cruisers and destroyers, they were checking the perimeter and checking for any possible threats in the region. *naval report, threat of undetected enemy fleets* Behind the fleet stretched the logistics train, 32 logistics vessels, twelve amphibious assault vessels, carrying the soldiers needed for the operation, and a dozen escort attack submarines diverted from their other fleets, they were well within the defensive perimeter of their fleet, so it shouldn't be a problem to worry about

[/spoiler][/quote]
[b]Juane Island, Capricorn[/b]
[b][Jan.31.25][/b]

[i]The ringing of sirens flooded the island, military officials scattered to organize their forces and divisions. Amiral Étienne Leclerc rushed to central command to get a grasp of the current situation. "[b]We've received over 65 unidentified signatures within a 200KM radius of Juane.[/b]" reported one of the data analysts. Admiral Étienne looked closer at the screen, "[b]Go into Satelite view, something's not right..[/b]." the analyst complied and entered 3D satelite view. He zoomed into the Naval vessels before pausing. "[b]These are no commercial vessels..., THEY'RE BRAVANORIAN COMBAT VESSELS![/b]" the atmosphere soon devolved into panic, a combat force of such size would be a tedious task to expel. "[b]READY THE COASTAL DEFENSE BATTERIES![/b]" Étienne ordered, he quickly ran out the Command Center towards the living quarters of the military base. Dashing through halls and corners before reaching the Maharaja Family's living quarters. He soon barged in, "[b]Pack your clothes, your food, everything! You will be relocated to mainland Gendarme where it's safe, we seem to have an unexpected guest.[/b]" the Maharaja's family was large, the fact they have to flee from the Raj to Capricorn, then to flee again to Gendarme was not the best news they could receive. But it had to be done, or else they could risk capture. The family quickly followed the Admiral as he led them through multiple halls until they reached an underground hidden tunnel system, these tunnels would lead them straight towards Base aérienne de Juane, an aerial quarters that would allow them to escape the islands that will soon become a warzone.[/i]

[b]Chantier naval de La Forge de Juane[/b]
[pre]The Gendarmite Capricornian fleet was able to organize itself quickly, an interception force of 4 Destroyers, 6 Corvettes, 2 Amphibious Assualt ships, 3 Submarines, and 2 Support ships would be called upon in this time of Emergency. Capricorn would be declared under martial law while Alicia would begin to mobilize its standing army. The Gendarmite 4th and 12 Colonial garrisons would be activated and reservist forces are to be mobilized. These actions would bring the garrisons within Capricorn to a standing of 10.000, while Coastal Defenses and SAM launchers would take positions all over the islands to ensure the hostile enemy didn't have the potential to salvo the islands.[/pre]
